golden_mode: Explicit HDC_V41_ARITH=chunk8 for all me,qe,he,att,idx,su classes; default is legacy and must not be assumed chunk8. No norm-folding/fusion contract changes.

invariants.rule: Each golden add/mul is binary32 RNE, gradual underflow, canonical +0. Preserve separate mul and add rounding; no FMA replacement. FP32 hc.fn weights may not be narrowed to BF16.

Matrix activation BF16 rounding precedes products. Weights for true BF16 paths remain BF16. Accumulate 8 consecutive products from +0, then adjacent pairwise tree padded with +0 to power of two. Final BF16 rounding only where golden linear_bf16 requires; head mv emits FP32 logits.

FP8 activation quantization per32 is E4M3 RNE/saturation with exact golden amax floor and UE8M0 scale. FP4 expert weight is E2M1 with per-row per32 exponent; FP8 weight exponent generally shared by32x32 block. Exact integer dot32 is rounded ONCE to FP32 before scale by2^(we+xe), then chunk8 sum of these scaled block terms, padded adjacent tree, output BF16. Do not replace by BF16 products accumulated individually.
wo_a checkpoint FP8 codes are dequantized to BF16 weights and consume BF16 activations via me contract, not linear_q activation re-quantization.

Full K per SM with independent row partitions matches reused SM contract. K-split partials legal only for canonical aligned power-of-two subtrees, and upper merge must reproduce padded tree. Equal arbitrary K rank partitions + generic allreduce are forbidden.

Router topk score+bias tie lower global expert index. Selected ids sorted ascending. Routing denominator sums raw scores in that order. Weight multiplies SiLU(g)*clipped_up before BF16 activation rounding and down QE; cannot move after down matrix. Output experts added sequentially in ascending id, shared expert LAST, then BF16. Concurrent expert execution permitted with ordered retirement.

Independent rows may retire out of order if row tags retained and argmax compares score then lower GLOBAL row id; head output logits stay FP32. Preserve any downstream MTP markov addition before token selection.

Different matrix/expert/token contexts must not share accumulator or operand state. Descriptor/address bounds and identity checks stay. Drain actual arithmetic and result acceptance before bank/source reuse; model x upload visibility (DW), start/release, credits and return stalls.

Attention KV FP4 E4M3-scale block16 and index FP4 UE8M0 block32 are different contracts from QE ROM weights. Keep dedicated validated engines. hc.fn [24,20480] FP32 weights uses separate dedicated HE/FP32 engine, because reusable SM exposes only BF16/FP8/FP4 formats.

minimum_full_shape_component_gates.rows: Full selected tile row share, not full die
minimum_full_shape_component_gates.check: Real checkpoint FP4 plus FP8 activations, prequantization/amaxes/scales, exact block terms and final BF16; both gate/up and context change
Full K down after routed weight BEFORE BF16 quantization; one selected full-width component row share
Every distinct configured K shape, full tile row share; exponents shared across row32 boundary and FP8 four active-lane padding
Head full K for one complete return/compute group; FP32 logits; router shape same K BF16 weights; partial final row group and lower-global-id argmax ties
One complete native group K; checkpoint FP8-dequant BF16 path and BF16 output, no activation requantization
Dedicated existing HE path binding source hashes; no claim generic reusable tile covers it

Full-K cases with ROM stalls at slot wrap, scale/read boundary, op switch FP4->BF16->FP8; nonmultiple row count; result stalls; x upload visibility; cancellation, positive/negative zeros, subnormals, exponent extremes, RNE ties, saturation boundaries; no dropped/duplicate result tags and finite buffers
Single expert gate/up->SiLU clip/routing multiply->down plus small ordered-retirement controller for six tagged expert results and shared last; no whole array/die simulation

adoption_gates: Source-pinned golden exact PASS on selected full-shape component
Model includes every upload, config, ROM read/capture, queue, issue bubble, recurrence, tree, result retirement and CDC cycle
SS setup and FF hold at unchanged60ps/25ps uncertainty in actual clustered context
Default-off candidate; actual >=1% composed per-user rate gain before adoption
